white_stem_borer: Scirpophaga innotata, known as white stem borer
dead central shoots and wilting leaves, with holes, tunnels and frass inside the stem, and white empty heads on older plants
xamthomonas: Xanthomonas spp., commonly known as bacterial spot
water-soaked angular lesions that turn brown and dry, surrounded by yellow halos, often along the leaf edge and veins, leaves yellowing and withering
yellow_leaf_curl_virus: Begomovirus spp., known as leaf curl virus
small leaves curling upward and cupping, with bright yellow margins, plants stunted and bushy with short internodes and few flowers
yellow_mosaic: Mosaic virus spp., known as yellow mosaic
bright yellow and green mosaic patches over the whole leaf, irregular yellow blotches mixed with normal green tissue, leaves slightly puckered and smaller
yellow_mosaic_virus: Yellow mosaic virus, known as yellow mosaic
bright yellow mosaic patches spreading over the leaf between green areas, leaves mottled, puckered and smaller than normal, plants stunted with few pods
yellow_rust: Puccinia striiformis, known as yellow rust
small bright yellow powdery pustules arranged in long stripes along the leaf between the veins, leaves yellowing and drying when heavily infected
yellow_spots: Chlorotic lesions, known as yellow spots
small round yellow spots scattered over the green leaf surface, sometimes merging into larger pale patches, without dark borders or mould
yellow_stem_borer: Scirpophaga incertulas, known as yellow stem borer
dead central shoots that pull out easily, and white empty grain heads standing upright, with small holes and frass in the lower stem
yellowing: Chlorosis from stress, known as yellowing
general yellowing of the leaves, starting pale green and turning yellow over the whole blade, without spots, mould or lesions
